item.title: TIER IV and Renesas team up on open AI-native computing platform for autonomous vehicles
item.summary: A new collaboration between TIER IV and Renesas could shape how self-driving and software-defined vehicles are built worldwide, as automakers seek more flexible platforms for AI-driven features. The effort aims to combine open-source software, advanced chips, and scalable tools that may accelerate safer mobility across markets from Asia to Europe to North America.
